notes: «عنه» opens the report as a back_reference: the previous reports open with «عنه» or give no chain, so nothing is taken over and the reference stands as written
«سمعت أبا عبدالله يقول: كان أمير المؤمنين يقول»: the Imam is named in the words, and Ali is the speaker quoted inside them; both are written in order (owner rulings 2, 5)
